description: Read Claude's replies aloud in the Jarvis voice; stop talking when you send a new prompt.

hooks.command: command -v jarvis >/dev/null 2>&1 && jarvis hook prompt || true
command -v jarvis >/dev/null 2>&1 && jarvis hook tool || true
command -v jarvis >/dev/null 2>&1 && jarvis hook tool-done || true
command -v jarvis >/dev/null 2>&1 && jarvis hook stop || true
